listening-text-1.speaker: W
listening-text-1.en: Jack, are you going camping with your friends this weekend?
listening-text-1.zh: Jack，这个周末你要和朋友们去露营吗？

listening-text-1.speaker: M
listening-text-1.zh: 如果天气晴朗，我们就去。

listening-text-1.speaker: W
listening-text-1.en: The weatherman says it’s going to rain.

listening-text-1.speaker: M
listening-text-1.en: In that case, we’ll go to the cinema instead.
listening-text-1.zh: 那样的话，我们就改去电影院。

listening-text-2.speaker: W
listening-text-2.en: Excuse me, could you mind my bags for a moment?
listening-text-2.zh: 打扰一下，能帮我照看一会儿包吗？

listening-text-2.speaker: W
listening-text-2.en: I want to buy some food at the convenience store.
listening-text-2.zh: 我想去便利店买点吃的。

listening-text-2.speaker: M
listening-text-2.en: It was announced that my train would arrive in 10 minutes.
listening-text-2.zh: 刚才广播说我的火车将在十分钟后到达。

listening-text-3.speaker: W
listening-text-3.en: Bob came out of hospital last Friday.

listening-text-3.speaker: W
listening-text-3.en: Have you got a chance to visit him?

listening-text-3.speaker: M
listening-text-3.en: I plan to see him this Saturday.

listening-text-3.speaker: W
listening-text-3.en: Aren’t you going to the conference then?
listening-text-3.zh: 你那时不是要去开会吗？

listening-text-3.speaker: M
listening-text-3.en: It has been rescheduled for next Monday.
listening-text-3.zh: 会议已经改到下周一了。

listening-text-4.speaker: M
listening-text-4.en: We made a terrible mistake adding up the bill.
listening-text-4.zh: 我们算账单时出了个大错。

listening-text-4.speaker: M
listening-text-4.en: Here is the ten dollars we have to return to you.
listening-text-4.zh: 这是我们该退给你的十美元。

listening-text-5.speaker: W
listening-text-5.en: Do you think we should get Steve a book for the new year?
listening-text-5.zh: 你觉得我们该给 Steve 买本书当新年礼物吗？

listening-text-5.speaker: M
listening-text-5.en: But Steve wouldn’t take just any book.
listening-text-5.zh: 不过 Steve 可不是什么书都喜欢。

listening-text-5.speaker: M
listening-text-5.en: He has had this particular one on geography.
listening-text-5.zh: 他已经有了这本地理方面的书。

listening-text-6.speaker: W
listening-text-6.en: I can’t come for dinner tonight.
listening-text-6.zh: 我今晚不能来吃晚饭了。

listening-text-6.speaker: W
listening-text-6.en: We’ve got a new case and things get pretty crazy here in the office.
listening-text-6.zh: 我们接了一个新案子，办公室里忙得不可开交。

listening-text-6.speaker: M
listening-text-6.en: Well, then I’ll come to you.

listening-text-6.speaker: W
listening-text-6.en: Let me see if I can arrange another night.
listening-text-6.zh: 我看看能不能另约一个晚上。

listening-text-6.speaker: W
listening-text-6.en: Then tell me on the phone.
listening-text-6.zh: 那就在电话里告诉我吧。

listening-text-6.speaker: M
listening-text-6.en: No, it’s better if we do it in person.
listening-text-6.zh: 不，我们还是当面谈比较好。

listening-text-6.speaker: W
listening-text-6.en: You can give me a call tomorrow afternoon.
listening-text-6.zh: 你明天下午可以给我打个电话。

listening-text-7.speaker: W
listening-text-7.en: Jim will call on us this afternoon.
listening-text-7.zh: Jim 今天下午要来我们家。

listening-text-7.speaker: W
listening-text-7.en: Do you know where he is now?
listening-text-7.zh: 你知道他现在在哪儿吗？

listening-text-7.speaker: M
listening-text-7.en: He has sent two messages saying that he’s done with his work at the office and got a taxi and... and he’ll arrive in twenty minutes.
listening-text-7.zh: 他发了两条消息，说办公室的工作做完了，已经打了辆出租车，而……而且他二十分钟后就到。

listening-text-7.speaker: W
listening-text-7.en: We can’t keep him waiting outside our home.
listening-text-7.zh: 我们不能让他在家门外等。

listening-text-7.speaker: M
listening-text-7.en: But it takes at least half an hour to get to the city center by bus.
listening-text-7.zh: 可是坐公交车到市中心至少要半小时。

listening-text-7.speaker: W
listening-text-7.en: We can save at least twenty minutes by walking through the park.
listening-text-7.zh: 从公园穿过去，至少能省二十分钟。

listening-text-8.speaker: W
listening-text-8.en: Morning, Mark.
listening-text-8.zh: 早上好，Mark。

listening-text-8.speaker: M
listening-text-8.en: Morning, Clara.
listening-text-8.zh: 早上好，Clara。

listening-text-8.speaker: M
listening-text-8.en: How was your weekend?
listening-text-8.zh: 周末过得怎么样？

listening-text-8.speaker: W
listening-text-8.en: Great.
listening-text-8.zh: 很好。

listening-text-8.speaker: W
listening-text-8.en: I went to my grandpa’s.
listening-text-8.zh: 我去了爷爷家。

listening-text-8.speaker: W
listening-text-8.en: He invited us to pick vegetables on his farm.
listening-text-8.zh: 他邀请我们去他的农场摘蔬菜。

listening-text-8.speaker: W
listening-text-8.en: My daughter had a great time there.
listening-text-8.zh: 女儿在那里玩得很开心。

listening-text-8.speaker: W
listening-text-8.en: What about you?
listening-text-8.zh: 你呢？

listening-text-8.speaker: M
listening-text-8.en: Oh, I had a truly incredible experience.
listening-text-8.zh: 哦，我遇到了一件真不可思议的事。

listening-text-8.speaker: M
listening-text-8.en: I dropped by a yard sale on Saturday and got several books.
listening-text-8.zh: 周六我顺路去了一场庭院旧货出售活动，买了几本书。

listening-text-8.speaker: W
listening-text-8.en: Novels?
listening-text-8.zh: 小说吗？

listening-text-8.speaker: M
listening-text-8.en: A novel and two poetry collections.
listening-text-8.zh: 一本小说和两本诗集。

listening-text-8.speaker: M
listening-text-8.en: As I leafed through the novel, a piece of paper fell out.
listening-text-8.zh: 我翻小说时，一张纸掉了出来。

listening-text-8.speaker: M
listening-text-8.en: It was an air ticket from 2012.
listening-text-8.zh: 那是一张 2012 年的机票。

listening-text-8.speaker: M
listening-text-8.en: The flight was from Los Angeles to Chicago and the name on the ticket was Ashley Louis.
listening-text-8.zh: 航班从洛杉矶飞往芝加哥，票上的名字是 Ashley Louis。

listening-text-8.speaker: W
listening-text-8.en: Was it?
listening-text-8.zh: 是吗？

listening-text-8.speaker: M
listening-text-8.en: Yes.
listening-text-8.zh: 对。

listening-text-8.speaker: M
listening-text-8.en: Ashley, my sister.
listening-text-8.zh: Ashley 是我姐妹。

listening-text-8.speaker: M
listening-text-8.en: In 2012, she lived in Los Angeles and her husband worked in Chicago.
listening-text-8.zh: 2012 年她住在洛杉矶，她丈夫在芝加哥工作。

listening-text-8.speaker: M
listening-text-8.en: Both of them often flew between two cities.
listening-text-8.zh: 他们经常在两座城市之间飞来飞去。

listening-text-8.speaker: M
listening-text-8.en: I asked the seller where he got the book.
listening-text-8.zh: 我问卖家从哪儿买到这本书。

listening-text-8.speaker: M
listening-text-8.en: He said it was bought at a second-hand bookstore in Los Angeles three years ago.
listening-text-8.zh: 他说是三年前在洛杉矶的一家旧书店买的。

listening-text-8.speaker: M
listening-text-8.en: Last year, he and his family moved from Los Angeles to Philadelphia.
listening-text-8.zh: 去年，他和家人从洛杉矶搬到了费城。

listening-text-8.speaker: W
listening-text-8.en: So, all the way across the country, your sister’s old book landed in your hands.
listening-text-8.zh: 所以，横跨整个国家之后，你姐妹的旧书竟到了你手里。

listening-text-8.speaker: W
listening-text-8.en: That’s really crazy.
listening-text-8.zh: 真是太不可思议了。

listening-text-9.speaker: W
listening-text-9.en: Victor, you’ve been here in Indiana for six weeks now.
listening-text-9.zh: Victor，你到印第安纳州已经六周了。

listening-text-9.speaker: W
listening-text-9.en: How are you feeling?
listening-text-9.zh: 感觉怎么样？

listening-text-9.speaker: M
listening-text-9.en: I think I’ve got used to college life, going to classes, working out and hanging out with my friends.
listening-text-9.zh: 我想我已经适应大学生活了：上课、锻炼、和朋友们一起玩。

listening-text-9.speaker: M
listening-text-9.en: Though there’s pressure to meet deadlines, life here is never boring.
listening-text-9.zh: 虽然有按时完成任务的压力，但这里的生活一点也不无聊。

listening-text-9.speaker: W
listening-text-9.en: What’s been hard about being an Indianan basketball player?
listening-text-9.zh: 作为印第安纳州的篮球队员，什么让你觉得困难？

listening-text-9.speaker: M
listening-text-9.en: Well, the training is very competitive, weightlifting and running every day.
listening-text-9.zh: 嗯，训练竞争性很强，每天都要举重和跑步。

listening-text-9.speaker: M
listening-text-9.en: It’s not like high school.
listening-text-9.zh: 这跟高中不一样。

listening-text-9.speaker: M
listening-text-9.en: In high school, I really didn’t have to do that.
listening-text-9.zh: 高中时，我确实不用做那些训练。

listening-text-9.speaker: M
listening-text-9.en: I’m just trying to get used to it.
listening-text-9.zh: 我正在努力适应。

listening-text-9.speaker: M
listening-text-9.en: And I think I am.
listening-text-9.zh: 我觉得自己渐渐适应了。

listening-text-9.speaker: W
listening-text-9.en: At this point, how do you see yourself fitting into this group?
listening-text-9.zh: 到目前为止，你觉得自己融入这个集体的情况怎么样？

listening-text-9.speaker: M
listening-text-9.en: I think we’re all different.
listening-text-9.zh: 我觉得我们各不相同。

listening-text-9.speaker: M
listening-text-9.en: George is from Britain.
listening-text-9.zh: George 来自英国。

listening-text-9.speaker: M
listening-text-9.en: Chris and Leo are from Australia.
listening-text-9.zh: Chris 和 Leo 来自澳大利亚。

listening-text-9.speaker: M
listening-text-9.en: I’m from France.
listening-text-9.zh: 我来自法国。

listening-text-9.speaker: M
listening-text-9.en: And the rest are Americans.
listening-text-9.zh: 其余都是美国人。

listening-text-9.speaker: M
listening-text-9.en: But I get along with everybody.
listening-text-9.zh: 不过我和每个人都相处得很好。

listening-text-9.speaker: M
listening-text-9.en: You know, we are really starting to bond.
listening-text-9.zh: 你知道，我们真正在开始建立紧密的联系。

listening-text-9.speaker: M
listening-text-9.en: It’s great to see how we grow each day as a team.
listening-text-9.zh: 看着我们作为一个团队每天成长，感觉真好。

listening-text-9.speaker: W
listening-text-9.en: Thanks, Victor.
listening-text-9.zh: 谢谢你，Victor。

listening-text-9.speaker: W
listening-text-9.en: I wish you a very happy and fruitful stay in Indiana.
listening-text-9.zh: 祝你在印第安纳州生活愉快、收获丰富。

listening-text-10.speaker: W
listening-text-10.zh: 亲爱的听众朋友们，晚上好。

listening-text-10.speaker: W
listening-text-10.en: When was the last time you enjoyed leisure activities?
listening-text-10.zh: 你上一次享受休闲活动是什么时候？

listening-text-10.speaker: W
listening-text-10.en: Do you want to live a full and happy life?
listening-text-10.zh: 你想过充实而快乐的生活吗？

listening-text-10.speaker: W
listening-text-10.en: Today, I’m going to introduce to you a magazine that features the art of living.
listening-text-10.zh: 今天我要向大家介绍一本以生活艺术为特色的杂志。

listening-text-10.speaker: W
listening-text-10.en: The Idler was launched by Tom Hodgkinson, back in 1993.
listening-text-10.zh: 《The Idler》由 Tom Hodgkinson 于 1993 年创办。

listening-text-10.speaker: W
listening-text-10.en: With the intention of providing a bit of fun, freedom and achievement in the busy world, it is now published bimonthly.
listening-text-10.zh: 它旨在忙碌的世界里带来一些乐趣、自由和成就感，现在每两个月出版一期。

listening-text-10.speaker: W
listening-text-10.en: In every issue, you will find an interesting mix of interviews and essays on the good life, history, philosophy, arts and fashion photography.
listening-text-10.zh: 每期都有丰富有趣的访谈和随笔，涉及美好生活、历史、哲学、艺术及时尚摄影。

listening-text-10.speaker: W
listening-text-10.en: You will find much to laugh at and much useful stuff as well, from recipes for making bacon to guides to housekeeping.
listening-text-10.zh: 你既能看到许多令人发笑的内容，也能找到实用知识，从制作培根的食谱到家务指南，应有尽有。

listening-text-10.speaker: W
listening-text-10.en: If you ever felt that there is more to life than boring jobs, then why not subscribe to it?
listening-text-10.zh: 如果你觉得生活不只是无聊的工作，何不订阅它呢？

listening-text-10.speaker: W
listening-text-10.en: The Idler is a cheering read that makes you feel better about life.
listening-text-10.zh: 《The Idler》读来令人振奋，让你对生活感觉更好。

listening-text-10.speaker: W
listening-text-10.en: You can download the application and subscribe today to get your first issue free.
listening-text-10.zh: 今天就可以下载应用并订阅，免费领取第一期。
